ModMetaData.name: Faction Leader Fix
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Restores missing faction leaders when a save is loaded.
Fixes this error after loading a save: Faction leader for [faction name] is null.
Cause: Every visible humanlike faction is supposed to have a leader. If the leader reference is lost (for example the leader pawn was removed from the world by another mod), the save stores a null leader. Vanilla FactionTick only logs the error and never repairs it.
Fix: Calls vanilla's own TryGenerateNewLeader() for any faction that should have a leader but has none, the same way vanilla replaces a leader who died. Each faction is tried at most once per session.
Notes: - Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. The new leader is saved normally. - No letter is sent. Each repaired faction writes one line to the log. - Load after Harmony.
This mod was developed with the help of AI coding tools (Claude Code). Full source code is included in the Source folder for review.
